Caption:
How the wealthy pay $0 in taxes 💰
Most people work, get paid, and lose a huge chunk to taxes before they even see their money. The wealthy? They play by a different set of rules—and it’s all 100% legal.
Here’s how:
🔹 Let the business pay – Travel, meals, even luxury cars? If used for business, they’re tax-deductible expenses, reducing taxable income before the IRS takes a cut.
🔹 Use assets, not paychecks – Instead of taking a salary like an employee (and getting taxed heavily), business owners borrow against their assets. Since loans aren’t income, they aren’t taxed.
🔹 Leverage investments – Selling stocks triggers capital gains taxes. The wealthy? They use investments as collateral to borrow cash—no taxes owed.
The system isn’t broken. It’s just built for those who understand it.
